unit.why: A quotation from a book on Yiddish (לשון אשכנז) as a 'curtain' between holiness and the seventy languages, followed by the teacher's dream image of the Messiah's limbs being arranged through la'az, offered as an exegetical hint with no narrative development.
unit.boundary_note: Part of a series of quoted teachings; the previous and next divisions are separate citations (the next one, on a dream-question about the Messiah's coming, may hold a short narrative).
